replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces dimensions by finding directions (principal components) that capture most variance in data. It involves standardizing data, computing the covariance matrix, eigendecomposition, and projecting data onto the top eigenvectors. The math is manageable with practice—start with small datasets and focus on the big picture rather than complex formulas.
